newsitem.title: USA: Univec says shr drop unrelated to business.
newsitem.headline: Univec says shr drop unrelated to business.

text.p: Univec Inc said Tuesday its recent decline in the price of its stock is not related to its current business developments, which it said are positive.
The stock closed Monday near its 52-week low of 1 and 1/8.

The company said the decline in the stock price cannot be accounted for by any events in its business. It said the business is on or ahead of every target it made during the period immediately prior to its public offering two months ago.
